'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Casey Anis LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet Casey Anis Profit / You Can Either Profit By This. Scan-verified LS.
